spec: Money is held in whole minor units. A transfer never overdraws the source account, even when transfers run at the same time, and never moves money between currencies. The refunds on a charge never add up to more than the charge. An adjustment is rounded half away from zero, so 2.5 becomes 3 and -2.5 becomes -3.

candidates.claim: total adds amounts as floating-point numbers, so sums of many amounts drift by fractions of a minor unit.
transfer can overdraw the source account when two transfers from it run at the same time, because the balance check and the debit are separate steps.
refund lets the refunds on a charge add up to more than the charge, because it compares each refund only with the charge amount.
transfer moves money between accounts in different currencies without any check.
roundAdjustment rounds -2.5 to -2, not -3, because Math.round rounds halves toward positive infinity.
